command_display:
bash -lc '
set -euo pipefail
range=d33c62eebc48de5e8a65c50e057addf25f125c6b..51e7faddad943ab7727e407d008e474ec076566d
printf "added_comment_lines_by_production_file_top25\n"
git diff --unified=0 "$range" -- "src/**/*.cpp" "src/**/*.cppm" "src/**/*.hpp" "src/**/*.h" |
awk '"'"'
/^\+\+\+ b\// { file=substr($0,7); next }
/^\+[^+]/ {
  line=substr($0,2)
  if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*(\/\/\/|\/\/|\/\*|\*)/) print file
}
'"'"' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | sed -n "1,25p"
printf "representative_hotspot_comment_lines\n"
git diff --unified=0 "$range" --   src/graphics/renderer/Graphics.Renderer.cpp   src/graphics/renderer/Graphics.Renderer.cppm   src/runtime/Kernel/Runtime.Engine.cpp   src/runtime/Rendering/Runtime.RenderExtraction.cpp   src/runtime/Rendering/Runtime.RenderExtraction.cppm   src/runtime/Editor/Operations/Runtime.GeometryProcessingOperations.Mesh.cpp   src/runtime/Scene/Runtime.SelectionController.cppm   src/runtime/GeometryIntegration/Runtime.PrimitiveSelectionRefinement.cppm |
awk '"'"'
/^\+\+\+ b\// { file=substr($0,7); next }
/^\+[^+]/ {
  line=substr($0,2)
  if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*(\/\/\/|\/\/|\/\*|\*)/) print file "\t" line
}
'"'"' | sed -n "1,220p"
'
